description: New function: string validation utility for product SKUs
acceptance_criteria: Tests are written before implementation code
Tests cover valid inputs, invalid inputs, and edge cases (empty string, None)
Tests follow AAA pattern (Arrange-Act-Assert)
Implementation is minimal — only enough to pass the tests
At least 5 distinct test cases exist

description: New function: shopping cart price calculator with discounts
acceptance_criteria: Tests are written before implementation code
Tests cover: empty cart, single item, multiple items, percentage discount, fixed discount, combined discounts
Tests follow AAA pattern (Arrange-Act-Assert)
Edge cases tested: negative prices, zero quantity, discount exceeding total
Implementation handles all discount types correctly

description: Bug fix: off-by-one error in pagination logic
acceptance_criteria: A regression test is written first that reproduces the off-by-one bug
The regression test fails before the fix is applied
Fix is minimal and targeted to the pagination logic
Additional boundary tests added: first page, last page, single-item page, empty result set
Tests follow AAA pattern

description: Bug fix: race condition in cache invalidation
acceptance_criteria: A regression test is written that demonstrates stale cache reads
Test uses concurrent execution (threading or asyncio) to trigger the race
Fix introduces proper locking or atomic operations
Tests verify cache consistency after concurrent writes
Tests follow AAA pattern

description: Refactor: extract authentication logic from request handler
acceptance_criteria: Tests for the extracted auth module are written before extraction
Tests cover: valid token, expired token, malformed token, missing token, insufficient permissions
Existing handler tests still pass after refactor
Extracted module has a clean interface (no HTTP framework dependency)
Tests follow AAA pattern

description: Refactor: replace callback pattern with async/await
acceptance_criteria: Tests for the async version are written before refactoring
Tests verify identical behavior to the callback version
Tests cover success path, error propagation, and timeout
Async tests use pytest-asyncio or equivalent
Callback-based tests are preserved as regression tests

description: Edge cases: file upload with size and type validation
acceptance_criteria: Tests are written before implementation
Tests cover: valid file, oversized file, zero-byte file, wrong MIME type, spoofed extension, multiple files
Tests verify magic byte detection (not just extension)
Tests cover boundary conditions: exactly at size limit, one byte over
Error messages are user-friendly and specific
At least 10 distinct test cases exist

description: Edge cases: currency conversion with rounding rules
acceptance_criteria: Tests are written before implementation
Tests cover: standard conversion, inverse conversion, same-currency no-op, chained conversion
Tests verify banker's rounding (round half to even)
Tests cover zero amounts, very small amounts (sub-cent), very large amounts
Tests verify no floating-point precision loss (Decimal usage)
At least 10 distinct test cases exist
